fields.place: Multān (Punjab), according to the entry «Mukunda Gosvāmī»; Vṛndāvana
fields.works: A ṭīkā on the Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu (Artha-ratnālpa-dīpikā); the Siddhānta-candrodaya is attributed to him
fields.notes: Disciple of Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja (Sādhana-dīpikā). A deed of gift (Saṁvat 1773) of a land grant in Assam, received by his descending disciples, is in the collection of Satīśacandra Rāya. The entry «Mukunda Gosvāmī»: son of a rich merchant of Multān, he went to Vṛndāvana after a dream and became the disciple of Kṛṣṇadāsa; he brought the Caitanya-caritāmṛta to Multān and had the devotees copy it. The life of Mukunda Datta (Cakraśālā, Lord Caitanya's classmate) that was in this record went to his own record (06-11-2026).
